chosen_titles.rationale: Texas Government Code Title 3 Ch. 305 (Registration of Lobbyists) houses the state's lobbyist-registration and expenditure-disclosure regime.

notes: TX 2015 vintage available on Justia; identical structural lineage to TX 2009 known-good (Gov Code Title 3 Ch. 305). Other titles (Election Code = campaign finance, Penal Code = unrelated) intentionally excluded per scope.
